details.detail: Overall massing and seat layout: 2-4-2 blocks, tall reclined backs, headrest with navy flap, leg-rest panel, floor-standing consoles and aisle shrouds all read as the ZIM PY seat in p13a and q14. The silhouette is off in three places. The rear shells stand about 6 cm above the headrests as square-topped boards (p13a, st/p3). The consoles are too narrow. The shell tops have square front-view corners where the real ones have a large radius.

Rear shell and screen: the real shell top is at, or just below, the fabric headrest top (py_37303, and san_13 where the fabric band arcs over the shell top). Its top corners are rounded with R about 7-8 cm, and the screen sits recessed in the shell with the shell rim around it. The model shell rises to 0.97 against the headrest's 0.91 with square corners (only the depth is rounded, r = d/2), and the 0.44 x 0.30 screen housing is a box that stands 4 cm proud of a flat back (p15back, st/p2).

Headrest, wings and navy flap: the size and placement are right. The flap is 0.28 wide against a 0.46 back, about 61 % (py_37301 is about 60 %). The wings are thin separate sausages (0.10 x 0.26), angled 18 deg, with a crease against the back. In the photos the wings are the rounded ends of one wide headrest pad. The flap renders too dark and saturated: (40,48,90) against a back of (138,142,150), a ratio of about 0.34. py_37302 has flap (70,88,124) against back (109,122,142), about 0.7.

Fabric: the dash-row pitch and scale are fine from a normal distance. The colour is near neutral in the model (B-R about 12) but clearly blue-grey in py_37301/37302 (B-R about 33-41). Close up (p14c) the back fabric has large soft dark blotches and irregular white splotches mixed in with the dashes, which look like a second confetti layer or swatch dirt, not the woven dashes.

Centre console: it has the right elements (lid, nose, two pockets with blue triangles, twin universal sockets, red life-vest tab). It is too narrow. The model has w = 0.095. alv_09 gives about 0.16-0.17 m at socket level, using a universal socket plate of about 0.045 m (170 px) against a face of about 650 px. py_37301 gives about 0.35 x the cushion width (about 0.16 m). The pockets are solid blocks with a dark slot, not open U-lipped pockets. The blue triangles are at the top right on both pockets; the real ones are top-left on the upper pocket and bottom-right on the lower one.

Aisle and window shrouds: the side view (p7) matches py_37303 well: big flat outer face, darker recessed panel, silver strip low down, dark cap rounding over the front. From the front and rear (p1, p3, p15back) the shroud reads as a thin plank, 5 cm thick with a 7 cm cap.

Seat-back lower half: the literature pocket is modelled as a hood 5 cm proud with a trapezoid mesh basket. The real one (alv_05, alv_06) is a flat grey leatherette panel, about 0.34 wide, with a narrow horizontal mesh window, under a rigid upper stowage tray. The foot bar is one 0.20 m black cylinder on two side hangers, and there is also a separate pair of 'bicycle' pedals at y 0.13. In reality it is a single twin-pad bar, about 0.30 wide (two grey ribbed pads, silver end caps, a silver centre hub), on ONE central silver hanger arm. It folds from just under the pocket (alv_05) down to the floor (alv_06), so the pedal pair duplicates it.

Bottle bin on the console rear: the model has one 0.11 x 0.26 x 0.065 brushed box that reads as a tall post (p6, p2). The real bin is wide and shallow: two cells about 0.07 each (about 0.15 wide, about 0.10 tall), light grey, on top of a dark-grey pedestal carrying a white placard (alv_05, san_07).

Small parts: the screen placards match san_13/alv_13. The coat hook bullet overhangs the shell side edge by about 1 cm (x 0.235 + 0.035 > 0.2625); in san_13 it sits about 3 cm inboard, flat on the rear face. The reading-light goosenecks are right in count and path but read as black dangling cords in p13a/p4. The real arm is dark grey and about as thick as the model's.

issues.problem: The shell rises about 6 cm above the headrest with square front-view corners, so every row reads as grey tombstone boards behind the seats (p13a, st/p3). The real shell top is flush with, or just under, the headrest top and strongly rounded in the front view.

issues.detail: Screen housing sits on the shell instead of in it
issues.problem: The housing box stands 4 cm proud of a flat shell, so the back looks like a board with a TV bolted on (p15back). The real screen is recessed: the shell's thick side rims and top lip frame it, and only the bottom edge tilts out (san_13, san_05).
issues.fix: l.59-60: add a shell rim frame around the housing. For each side s: gRBox(0.04,0.32,0.05,0.012,1) at on(0.68,0.01,s*0.235) in pyShell, plus a top lip gRBox(0.47,0.03,0.05,0.012,1) at on(0.84,0.01) in pyShell. Reduce the housing projection: scr(0.02) -> scr(0.005), bezel 0.042 -> 0.027, screen 0.0495 -> 0.0345.

issues.problem: The flap is too dark and saturated (flap/back luminance about 0.34 in p13a against about 0.7 in py_37302). The back fabric is neutral grey (B-R about 12) where the photos show blue-grey (B-R about 33-41).
issues.fix: SEATMAT (shared, one line each): pyCover c -> about #3a4a72 (lighter, less saturated); pyFabric c -> push toward blue-grey, about #8f9bb0. Keep the swatch mean-relative.

issues.problem: Seen close (p14c, x2/p14c), the back fabric shows large soft dark blotches and irregular white splotches over the dash weave, which look like dirt from the confetti layer or swatch. The real weave (alv_09, san_02) is uniform small dashes with no blotches.
issues.evidence: w2r/p14c.png (white splotches at about 240,330 / 330,345 / 60,400) vs ref/web/py/alv_09, san_02
issues.fix: Check the pyFabric/py_back layer in 03_tex.js or the tex swatch for a mixed-in confetti or low-frequency term. Drop the low-frequency amplitude (LAYER_PARAMS one-liner) or re-cut the swatch from a flatter patch (test/make_swatches.py).

issues.problem: The pockets are solid blocks with a dark slot above. The real ones are open U-lipped pockets. The blue triangles are top-right on both pockets; the real ones are upper pocket top-left and lower pocket bottom-right.
issues.fix: l.134: upper pocket x = xa - w/2 + 0.016, y = y + h*0.24 - 0.01. Lower pocket x = xa + w/2 - 0.016, y = y - h*0.45. Add a 0.004-thick lip: pocket front plate h*0.74 -> h*0.8, with the dark slot gBox depth 0.02 behind it.

issues.problem: The model has a hood 5 cm proud with a trapezoid basket. The real pocket is a flat leatherette panel about 0.34 wide with a narrow mesh window, stitched, nearly flush.
issues.fix: l.69-72: hood 0.38 x 0.035 x 0.055 -> panel gRBox(0.36,0.14,0.018,0.012,1) at on(0.15,0.012) in pyShell. Mesh window gBox(0.30,0.055,0.002) at on(0.14,0.022) in the grille material. Drop the side ribs l.70 or shrink them to 0.012 deep.

issues.problem: The pyTrim slab (l.126, length 0.545 centred at z -0.28, front at -0.5525) projects about 1 cm past the console body (front -0.54) and nose (-0.545) and reads as a light shelf in p1.

questionsForUser: Console width against seat width: photos suggest the centre console is about 0.15-0.17 m wide. With the 0.5525 m seat spacing that leaves about 0.42 m of cushion. Do you have ANA's or ZIM's published seat width (between armrests) for this PY seat, so I can tell which to trust?

The Alviator 2026 photos (alv_09) show a mottled leaf-like fabric, lighter and warmer than the dash weave in ANA's official py_3730x photos. Which fabric should the model follow for the SFO-NRT 212-seat aircraft?
